Hero.title: Operations Supervisor | E-Commerce Specialist
Hero.name: Adnan Al-Thour
Hero.headline: Grounded operational leadership across physical sites and digital commerce.
Hero.bio: Experienced operations supervisor with a practical background in both on-the-ground civil construction logistics and digital retail workflows. Focused on clear site coordination, reliable inventory control, and keeping day-to-day operations moving efficiently without bottlenecks.
Hero.cardDomain1Desc: Contractor coordination, on-site safety compliance, materials logistics (Moka tenure).
Hero.cardDomain2Desc: Store P&L, stock integrity, receiving procedures, shrinkage reduction (Masar tenure).
Hero.cardDomain3Desc: Catalog accuracy, order packaging, courier coordination, last-mile dispatch.
Hero.cardAvailabilityVal: Open to operational leadership & advisory roles

About.title: Hands-On Leadership with Practical Focus
About.lead: Effective operations don't come from theories—they come from being present on the ground, understanding the team's needs, and keeping systems organized.
About.narrative: My career has been built across two distinct environments: physical construction sites and digital retail platforms. Managing subcontractor crews and heavy material deliveries taught me strict safety standards and the value of clear schedules. Directing retail store operations and e-commerce fulfillment taught me the importance of inventory accuracy, fast order turnaround, and responsive customer service. In both worlds, my goal is straightforward: build reliable workflows that help teams execute smoothly.
About.quote: Operational excellence is not about reacting to bottlenecks—it is about designing resilient systems that make bottlenecks structurally impossible.

tenets.title: Site Discipline & Safety First
tenets.desc: Enforcing safety standards and clear task staging so crews work productively without avoidable hazards.

tenets.title: Inventory & Order Accuracy
tenets.desc: Keeping tight control over stock records, receiving audits, and packaging standards to eliminate shrinkage and errors.

tenets.title: Hands-On Problem Solving
tenets.desc: Staying close to the daily workflow to spot delays early and solve issues directly with the people doing the work.

tenets.title: Transparent Communication
tenets.desc: Setting clear expectations with subcontractors, suppliers, courier partners, and clients from day one.

Expertise.title: Professional Experience
Expertise.subtitle: Practical roles across construction site supervision, general store management, and digital commerce logistics.

moka.title: Construction Site Supervisor
moka.description: Directed day-to-day on-site operations for structural projects. Coordinated subcontractor teams, tracked heavy material deliveries, and ensured safety compliance according to civil engineering standards and project milestones.

masar.title: General Store Manager
masar.description: Managed daily retail store operations, staff supervision, and inventory receiving. Focused on reducing shrinkage, improving stock reconciliation, and maintaining reliable supplier relations.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce Store Manager
ecommerce.description: Supervised online store operations, catalog management, and order fulfillment. Streamlined picking and packing workflows to improve turnaround times and customer satisfaction.

delivery.title: Delivery Coordinator
delivery.description: Coordinated delivery couriers and last-mile shipments. Optimized daily routes, monitored carrier delivery times, and resolved shipment delays promptly.

customerService.title: Customer Service Representative
customerService.description: Handled customer inquiries, order updates, and service escalations. Provided solutions directly to clients and fed operational feedback back into the logistics and store teams.
